title: Best Green Campus Award
description: Recognized as the best green campus initiative among all NITs for our sustainable practices and environmental conservation efforts.

title: Tree Plantation Drive
description: Successfully planted over 5,000 saplings across the campus and surrounding areas in our annual tree plantation drive.

title: Solar Power Initiative
description: Installed solar panels across campus generating 200kW of clean renewable energy, reducing carbon footprint by 40%.

title: Waste Management Program
description: Implemented a comprehensive waste segregation and recycling program achieving 85% waste diversion from landfills.

title: Water Conservation Project
description: Rainwater harvesting system installed across campus saving over 10,000 liters of water annually.

title: Eco-Friendly Transportation
description: Promoting electric vehicles and bicycles on campus with dedicated charging stations and bike lanes.
